Provides insights about your customers and their Assured Workloads based on
your Sovereign Controls by Partners offering.

## Overview

The following types provide methods to make RPCs. They are a good starting point
to learn about this library.

- `CloudControlsPartnerCoreClient`: Service describing handlers for resources.
- `CloudControlsPartnerMonitoringClient`: Service describing handlers for resources.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `CloudControlsPartnerCoreClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudControlsPartnerV1
import GoogleWKT

func sample(organizationId: String, locationId: String, customerId: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudControlsPartnerV1.CloudControlsPartnerCoreClient()
  let items = client.listWorkloadsByItems(
    request: ListWorkloadsRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "organizations/\(organizationId)/locations/\(locationId)/customers/\(customerId)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-cloudcontrolspartner-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-cloudcontrolspartner-v1.git --from 0.5.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudControlsPartnerV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudControlsPartnerV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-cloudcontrolspartner-v1
```
